Bilingual Social Media Manager (Spanish/English) – Restaurants

Starlight Media

Países permitidosMéxico
Modalidad100% Remote (Flexible hours)
Idioma requeridoInglés y Español
Experiencia2+ years managing social media for businesses + Meta Ads
Salario$6,000 to $8,000 MXN/month ($175 USD per account, starting with 2 accounts)
HorarioPart-time (flexible + 1 weekly call in US Eastern time)
Tipo de contrataciónPart-time / Independent contractor
Fecha de publicación2026-11-28 (Límite: 2026-12-28)

Descripción del puesto

Manage content calendars, bilingual captions, publishing, and basic Meta Ads for Hispanic-market restaurant brands in the US, paid in USD via Wise or PayPal.

Funciones principales

  • Build monthly content calendars for restaurant accounts 2 months ahead.
  • Write captions in Spanish and English and schedule posts on Instagram, Facebook, and TikTok.
  • Manage stories, comments, messages, and run basic Meta awareness/traffic campaigns.
  • Prepare monthly performance reports and collaborate in ClickUp with the design/video team.

Requisitos

  • 2+ years managing social media for businesses and hands-on Meta Ads Manager experience.
  • Fluent marketing copy in Spanish and English.
  • Based in Mexico with own computer, stable internet, and availability for one weekly US ET call.

Beneficios

  • 100% remote with flexible hours and no video editing/design required.
  • Paid in USD via Wise or PayPal ($175 USD per account, scalable as you take more accounts).
